title: The custom changes and the encounter remains
meaning: Your union can preserve closeness through change when shared promises find a form you both choose in the present.
text: Faithfulness to what you share may appear more flexible in your partnership than it looks from outside. In the physical position, the Hierophant gives actions a recognised form: maintaining a custom, keeping your word and expressing shared values. In energy, the Wheel of Fortune encourages attention to changed circumstances and an available continuation. In emotions, the Lovers bring pleasure in mutual openness. It matters to feel that beneath a new form you still meet each other willingly and can name the encounter you want now, instead of silently performing a familiar scenario. The form remains connected to the people within it.

For example, you usually spend the month’s first free evening out. This time the timetable changes and only a morning is available. Breakfast can preserve the meaning of meeting if you both want it. **Keeping a promise can include a new choice made by you both today.** A moved custom need not be an inferior substitute. It can develop its own warmth without requiring identical enthusiasm for every suggested option as proof that your values are serious.

The difficulty appears if change tests the wish to be together. Another format supposedly means the previous one was insufficiently valued. Protecting closeness, you return to proving faithfulness. Meaning disappears behind a form that must be defended. Reciprocity is freer when disappointment can coexist with seeking a continuation, without making different preferences a measure of love or rejection of everything good between you.
